spec_match.rationale: Measures the exact contract of the change — transitionrun delivered within the same event-loop iteration's rendering update (step 3.11) — as rAF-ticks-until-event over 5 median-reported trials of a real transition.

interactive.rationale: The run button executes fresh trials each time; meters, status, and a per-trial log update from real measurements; the square visibly transitions.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises the whole change in one number; the 0-vs-1 tick meter delivers it.

edge_cases.rationale: A trial-reset race (re-arming while the return transition was still running made later trials time out) was caught by the harness and fixed with a 400ms settle; timeouts render as NaN trials excluded from the median.

references.rationale: Feature index cites https://chromestatus.com/feature/6312504658624512 plus the event-loop, transitions, and CSSOM-View specs.

conformance.rationale: The suite's same-iteration assertions are this lab's mechanism self-contained; on Chromium 141 they honestly fail (deferral measured).

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 CDP run after the fix: 5/5 trials measured a consistent 1 rAF tick (~15.6ms) — the genuine legacy deferral this change removes — with a clean console at both viewports; screenshots read.

telemetry_health.rationale: idt-latency-measured asserts with the median frames and delay.

design_system.rationale: 0-tick verdict emerald, deferral amber, on paper (AA); CSS variables only.

accessibility.rationale: Meters aria-live; the moving square is aria-hidden decoration with all state in text; native button.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Meters collapse under 640px; 0px overflow at 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×2000.

openQuestions.title: Confirm the 0-tick reading on Chrome 153
openQuestions.detail: On the spec-aligned engine the median should read 0 ticks with single-digit-ms delay; capture that to complete the before/after.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Keep animated visuals decorative and announce results as text.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The square is aria-hidden; meters and trial log are aria-live text.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Isolate repeated measurements from each other's side effects.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: 400ms settle after each reset so every trial creates a fresh transition — the fix the harness verification forced.

summary: Verified headlessly (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): after fixing a real trial-reset race the harness exposed, all five trials consistently measure the 1-tick legacy deferral on Chromium 141 — the exact behavior Chrome 153 removes. Clean console, both viewports, fresh-reload evidence.
